name: ocr-tesseract
description: OCR with the system Tesseract: text, hOCR or TSV from images or PDF pages in allowed directories, with language and page segmentation choices

nodes.title: List OCR languages
nodes.description: Lists the Tesseract language packs installed on this machine (codes such as eng, ind, chi_sim) for the `languages` parameter of ocr

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Recognise text
nodes.description: Reads text from an image (png, jpeg, tiff, bmp, gif, webp) or one page of a PDF with Tesseract, as plain text, hOCR (HTML with word boxes) or TSV (word, box, confidence); optionally saves it to OCR_TESSERACT_OUTPUT_DIR

input.description: Image or PDF inside OCR_TESSERACT_INPUT_DIRS (or OCR_TESSERACT_OUTPUT_DIR); absolute, ~/..., or relative to the first input directory

psm.description: Page segmentation mode: 3 automatic (default), 4 one column, 6 one block, 7 one line, 11 sparse text

dpi.description: Resolution PDF pages are rendered at

save_output.description: Also write the result to a new file in OCR_TESSERACT_OUTPUT_DIR

output_name.description: Start of the generated output file name (letters, digits, - and _; default: the input's name). A timestamp and random suffix are always added, so nothing is overwritten

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

tools.name: list_languages
tools.description: Lists the Tesseract language packs installed on this machine (codes such as eng, ind, chi_sim) for the `languages` parameter of ocr
